_about: Independent fan sites' feeds for each club (Salah, 2026-11-26: "We also should be pulling from team fan sites"): { <club id>: [{ name, url }] }. Read by scripts/api/news.mjs like the Guardian's club feeds: every story is about that club, goes in news/<club>.json only (never the general headlines), and is credited to the site by name. Only the headline, a short summary and the link are kept; a story is read on the site. Each feed was checked by hand: 200, RSS or Atom, recent items, robots.txt allows it. No betting-owned sites.
